name: Document Creation
description: Create a document with AI assistance. Gathers requirements, creates a draft, reviews, finalizes, and saves to the document system.

steps.name: Gather Requirements
steps.description: Analyze the request and gather document requirements
steps.additionalInstructions:
You are gathering requirements for a document creation task.

Analyze the input and extract:
1. Document type (must be one of: sop, strategy, plan, template, reference, output, custom)
2. Target audience
3. Key topics to cover
4. Tone and style preferences
5. Any specific sections or structure required
6. Length/depth expectations

Your output.requirements object MUST include:
- documentType: one of 'sop', 'strategy', 'plan', 'template', 'reference', 'output', 'custom'
- targetAudience: string
- topics: array of strings
- tone: string
- sections: array of strings
- lengthExpectation: string

steps.name: Create Draft
steps.description: Generate the initial document draft based on requirements
steps.additionalInstructions:
You are creating a document draft based on the gathered requirements.

Using the requirements from the previous step:
1. Create a well-structured document
2. Include all required sections
3. Match the specified tone and style
4. Ensure appropriate depth and length
5. Use clear headings and formatting (markdown)

Your output object MUST include:
- draft: the complete document content in markdown format
- summary: a 1-2 sentence summary of the document

steps.name: Review Draft
steps.description: Human review of the generated draft
steps.additionalInstructions:
Please review the generated document draft.

Check for:
- Accuracy of information
- Appropriate tone and style
- Completeness of required sections
- Any necessary corrections or additions

Add your feedback in the task notes before completing. Your feedback will be used to finalize the document.

steps.name: Finalize Document
steps.description: Incorporate feedback and produce final version for saving
steps.additionalInstructions:
You are finalizing the document based on review feedback.

1. Read the review feedback from the previous step
2. Incorporate all suggested changes
3. Polish the language and formatting
4. Ensure consistency throughout
5. Add any final touches

IMPORTANT: Your output object MUST include a 'document' object with these exact fields for saving to the document system:
- title: the document title (string)
- content: the complete finalized document in markdown format (string)
- summary: a brief 1-2 sentence summary (string)
- type: the document type from requirements - must be one of: 'sop', 'strategy', 'plan', 'template', 'reference', 'output', 'custom'
- tags: array of relevant tags (strings)
- status: 'draft' (documents start as drafts)

Also include:
- changesSummary: brief summary of what changes were made from the draft

steps.name: Save Document
steps.description: Save the finalized document to the document system
